limitations.closure_criteria: A separately versioned federation extension defines topology, delegation and coordination without weakening Seed invariants.
limitations.description: Seed validates local Authority material but does not define federation topology, discovery, routing or consensus.

limitations.closure_criteria: Monade and evidence extensions define those behaviours and conform to the active Seed package.
limitations.description: Seed recognizes terminal resolution records; it does not evaluate policy, execute work, acquire evidence or enforce effects.

limitations.closure_criteria: Each implementation profile publishes independent operational evidence.
limitations.description: Storage, durability, concurrency, recovery and availability guarantees are not selected by Seed.

limitations.closure_criteria: Keep the pinned TLAPS gate passing for the exact committed formal model and proof-module identities.
limitations.description: The abstract TLA+ Seed safety projection has an unbounded deductive proof covering all eleven registered state invariants and all four registered temporal safety properties.

limitations.closure_criteria: Publish an external audit tied to commit and package digest.
limitations.description: No independent third-party audit is bound to the exact 0.3 alpha package.

limitations.closure_criteria: Migration profiles explicitly map predecessor concepts into extensions and implementations update conformance claims.
limitations.description: Seed 0.3 is intentionally not wire- or semantic-compatible with the 0.2 status/enforcement workflow model.

limitations.closure_criteria: Add separate proofs only for concrete binding/digest construction, concrete Authority grant chains, selected terminal-commitment accumulator profiles, selected implementation profiles, liveness or cryptography where those stronger claims are required.
limitations.description: The generated canonical TLA+ projection is source-locked and behaviorally equivalent to SeedResolution.tla under the declared abstraction profile. Full refinement of natural-language semantics, concrete binding/digest construction, concrete Authority grant chains, concrete terminal-commitment accumulator/witness verification, implementations, liveness and cryptographic primitive security is not proved.

limitations.closure_criteria: Keep the projection parity, source/target digest checks and pinned TLAPS behavioral-equivalence gate passing for the exact committed identities.
limitations.description: The exact machine-readable Seed model is source-locked to a deterministic generated TLA+ projection, and TLAPS proves behavioral equivalence between that declared projection and SeedResolution.tla.
